title: Aguadilla analyzed in a 200-page SCU document

tellings.quote: they did like a 200page document on it a bunch of different experts people with PhDs.

plain: An object seen over Aguadilla, Puerto Rico, in 2013 was studied in a 200-page report by the Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies, a group of scientists who look at UAP, the newer official term for UFOs. Michels tells this himself while debating a skeptic, stressing that the report was written by many experts with PhDs. He raises it to show that the case has been studied in depth by qualified people.
